ContextEnrichmentConfig.description: Read, time and payload bounds independent of the later research capability.

enabled.description: Whether the bounded initial context pass runs before intake.
enabled.title: Enabled

max_chars.description: Most characters the pass may read in total.
max_chars.title: Max Chars

max_context_chars.description: Most characters of context carried forward to later steps.
max_context_chars.title: Max Context Chars

max_evidence.description: Most evidence items the pass may attach.
max_evidence.title: Max Evidence

max_files.description: Most files the pass may read.
max_files.title: Max Files

max_seconds.description: Longest the pass may run, so it cannot delay the run.
max_seconds.title: Max Seconds

max_sources.description: Most sources the pass may consult.
max_sources.title: Max Sources

DataPolicyConfig.description: What may leave the process (Jev, Langfuse).

send_repo_excerpts_to_jev.description: Whether repository text may leave the process in Jev calls.
send_repo_excerpts_to_jev.title: Send Repo Excerpts To Jev

telemetry_excerpts.description: How excerpts appear in telemetry: truncated, only a hash, or not at all.
telemetry_excerpts.title: Telemetry Excerpts

telemetry_max_field_chars.description: Longest text field written to telemetry before it is cut.
telemetry_max_field_chars.title: Telemetry Max Field Chars

DataPolicyConfig.title: DataPolicyConfig

conflict_threshold.description: Probability that evidence conflicts at which the conflict must be resolved before deciding.
conflict_threshold.title: Conflict Threshold

design_judgement_threshold.description: A criterion counts as a design judgement (a property of the proposed options that research cannot settle) when Jev's probability for that reading reaches this value.
design_judgement_threshold.title: Design Judgement Threshold

max_grounding_evidence.description: Most evidence items attached to one options request (bounds the host input).
max_grounding_evidence.title: Max Grounding Evidence

max_research_rounds.description: Most research rounds one decision may request before it hands the ranked options to a human.
max_research_rounds.title: Max Research Rounds

missing_min_probability.description: Lowest probability a kind of missing knowledge needs to be recorded as missing.
missing_min_probability.title: Missing Min Probability

preference_threshold.description: Probability that the choice turns on a human preference at which the human is asked.
preference_threshold.title: Preference Threshold

progress_epsilon.description: No material progress: every score moved by at most this between assessments after new evidence.
progress_epsilon.title: Progress Epsilon

require_option_grounding.description: Options generated for an unknown option set must cite the evidence they rest on; an ungrounded option is refused (True) or only flagged as a limitation (False).
require_option_grounding.title: Require Option Grounding

reserve_assessments.description: Final decision assessments whose Jev calls stay reserved (research must leave them).
reserve_assessments.title: Reserve Assessments

reserve_extra_options.description: Options added to the size of the reserved assessment (a human may add one when ranked).
reserve_extra_options.title: Reserve Extra Options

reserve_margin_calls.description: Calls kept beyond the reserved assessments for routing a child request and other overhead.
reserve_margin_calls.title: Reserve Margin Calls

satisfies_threshold.description: Probability that an option satisfies a criterion at which it passes (at or below one minus this it fails).
satisfies_threshold.title: Satisfies Threshold

sufficiency_threshold.description: Probability that evidence suffices for a criterion at which the criterion counts as answered; below it the criterion stays uncertain.
sufficiency_threshold.title: Sufficiency Threshold

enabled.description: Whether entity recognition runs on the caller's text before intake.
enabled.title: Enabled

index_path.description: Where the entity index is read from, relative to the repository root.
index_path.title: Index Path

max_ambiguity_candidates.description: Most candidate meanings kept for an ambiguous term.
max_ambiguity_candidates.title: Max Ambiguity Candidates

max_caller_chars.description: Most characters of the caller's text scanned for entities.
max_caller_chars.title: Max Caller Chars

max_lookups.description: Most index lookups per request, bounding recognition work.
max_lookups.title: Max Lookups

max_meaning_chars.description: Longest meaning text kept per entity.
max_meaning_chars.title: Max Meaning Chars

max_seconds.description: Longest recognition may run, so it cannot delay the run.
max_seconds.title: Max Seconds

max_serialized_chars.description: Largest size of the entity context when carried in run state.
max_serialized_chars.title: Max Serialized Chars

max_unknown_chars.description: Longest text kept per unresolved term.
max_unknown_chars.title: Max Unknown Chars

source_ids.description: Sources whose entities may be recognised.
source_ids.title: Source Ids

enabled.description: Whether work may be handed to the host client at all.
enabled.title: Enabled

fallback_on_no_match.description: Whether a request no native capability matches falls back to the host.
fallback_on_no_match.title: Fallback On No Match

formulate_questions.description: Whether the host rewords questions for the human; false asks the original wording.
formulate_questions.title: Formulate Questions

max_input_chars.description: Most characters of input placed in one host packet.
max_input_chars.title: Max Input Chars

max_repair_attempts.description: How often a malformed host submission may be sent back for repair.
max_repair_attempts.title: Max Repair Attempts

IntentConfig.description: Thresholds for the intake answer-kind classification and the clarification cap.

max_clarifications.description: Most clarifying questions intake may ask for one request.
max_clarifications.title: Max Clarifications

min_confidence.description: Lowest provider confidence intake accepts for its classification.
min_confidence.title: Min Confidence

min_selected_probability.description: Lowest probability the chosen answer kind needs at intake.
min_selected_probability.title: Min Selected Probability

IntentConfig.title: IntentConfig

max_questions_per_call.description: Most questions batched into one Jev call.
max_questions_per_call.title: Max Questions Per Call

max_state_chars.description: Most characters of run state sent with a Jev call, bounding the input.
max_state_chars.title: Max State Chars

model.description: Name of the model Jev asks.
model.title: Model

price_per_input_token_usd.description: Price of one input token in US dollars, used to estimate cost; null when unknown.
price_per_input_token_usd.title: Price Per Input Token Usd

retry_backoff_seconds.description: Base delay before retrying a failed Jev call, doubled per retry.
retry_backoff_seconds.title: Retry Backoff Seconds

timeout_seconds.description: Longest one Jev call may take.
timeout_seconds.title: Timeout Seconds

transport.description: How Jev is reached: the local classifier or an HTTP service.
transport.title: Transport

backend.description: Knowledge backend: none turns graph retrieval off, neo4j serves it from Neo4j.
backend.title: Backend

database.description: Neo4j database to query; null uses the server default.
database.title: Database

embedding_dimensions.description: Vector size the embedding model returns, to match the stored index.
embedding_dimensions.title: Embedding Dimensions

embedding_endpoint_env.description: Name of the environment variable holding the embedding service URL.
embedding_endpoint_env.title: Embedding Endpoint Env

embedding_model.description: Embedding model to ask; required once embeddings are enabled.
embedding_model.title: Embedding Model

embedding_token_env.description: Name of the environment variable holding the embedding service token.
embedding_token_env.title: Embedding Token Env

embeddings_enabled.description: Whether embedding-based search supplements graph queries.
embeddings_enabled.title: Embeddings Enabled

neo4j_password_env.description: Name of the environment variable holding the Neo4j password.
neo4j_password_env.title: Neo4J Password Env

neo4j_uri_env.description: Name of the environment variable holding the Neo4j URI (never the URI).
neo4j_uri_env.title: Neo4J Uri Env

neo4j_username_env.description: Name of the environment variable holding the Neo4j user name.
neo4j_username_env.title: Neo4J Username Env

query_catalog_root.description: Folder of admitted query recipes; null means no query catalog.
query_catalog_root.title: Query Catalog Root

query_timeout.description: Seconds a graph query may run before it is cut off.
query_timeout.title: Query Timeout

repository_id.description: Repository whose knowledge graph is queried; part of every graph scope.
repository_id.title: Repository Id

repository_root.description: Local git checkout that resolves source text for graph hits; null for none.
repository_root.title: Repository Root

LangfuseConfig.description: Langfuse export settings (credentials come from secrets, never from here).

enabled.description: Whether traces are exported to Langfuse.
enabled.title: Enabled

environment.description: Langfuse environment label the traces are filed under.
environment.title: Environment

flush_on_exit.description: Whether pending traces are sent before the process exits.
flush_on_exit.title: Flush On Exit

trace_name.description: Name given to each run's trace.
trace_name.title: Trace Name

LangfuseConfig.title: LangfuseConfig

capability_timeout_seconds.description: Longest a single capability may run before it is cut off.
capability_timeout_seconds.title: Capability Timeout Seconds

langgraph_recursion_limit.description: Step limit handed to the graph engine, a backstop against endless graph loops.
langgraph_recursion_limit.title: Langgraph Recursion Limit

max_active_seconds.description: Most active seconds a run may spend before it stops.
max_active_seconds.title: Max Active Seconds

max_concurrent_host.description: Most host handoffs outstanding at once.
max_concurrent_host.title: Max Concurrent Host

max_concurrent_native.description: Most native capabilities running at once.
max_concurrent_native.title: Max Concurrent Native

max_cost_usd.description: Most estimated spend per run in US dollars; null means no cost cap.
max_cost_usd.title: Max Cost Usd

max_depth.description: Deepest chain of child requests a run may spawn.
max_depth.title: Max Depth

max_host_operations.description: Most host operations one run may hand off.
max_host_operations.title: Max Host Operations

max_jev_calls.description: Most Jev calls one run may make.
max_jev_calls.title: Max Jev Calls

max_retries.description: How often one work item is retried before it is marked failed.
max_retries.title: Max Retries

max_scheduler_iterations.description: Most scheduler rounds per run; null derives the limit from the graph recursion limit.
max_scheduler_iterations.title: Max Scheduler Iterations

max_work_items.description: Most work items one run may create, bounding runaway planning.
max_work_items.title: Max Work Items

no_progress_limit.description: Consecutive scheduler rounds without progress after which the run stops.
no_progress_limit.title: No Progress Limit

MemoryConfig.description: Decision store backend and precedent lookup settings.

applies_threshold.description: Jev's probability that a precedent applies at which it becomes evidence for the decision.
applies_threshold.title: Applies Threshold

backend.description: `file` reads docs/decisions through the generated index; `null` remembers nothing.
backend.title: Backend

criterion_evidence_max.description: Most evidence ids cited per criterion assessment and record criterion (not all of them).
criterion_evidence_max.title: Criterion Evidence Max

criterion_evidence_min_overlap.description: Content words an evidence item must share with a criterion to be cited for it.
criterion_evidence_min_overlap.title: Criterion Evidence Min Overlap

decisions_dir.description: The store folder, relative to the repository root.
decisions_dir.title: Decisions Dir

max_precedents.description: Most past decisions pulled into one decision (0 switches precedent lookup off).
max_precedents.title: Max Precedents

min_candidate_score.description: Content-word overlap a record's question must reach to be a candidate at all.
min_candidate_score.title: Min Candidate Score

repository_id.description: The repository part of a record's identity key (ADR-061); null uses the scope's workspace id.
repository_id.title: Repository Id

reuse_threshold.description: Jev's probability at which the human is asked to reuse the precedent or decide anew.
reuse_threshold.title: Reuse Threshold

MemoryConfig.title: MemoryConfig

PathsConfig.description: File-system locations (relative to the repository root unless absolute).

registry.description: Path of the capability registry that lists what the kernel can route to.
registry.title: Registry

run_root.description: Folder where each run's state and artifacts are written.
run_root.title: Run Root

PathsConfig.title: PathsConfig

ResearchConfig.description: Research-graph thresholds and category descriptions offered to Jev.

allow_synthesis.description: Whether research may ask the host to synthesise findings from the evidence.
allow_synthesis.title: Allow Synthesis

answer_aware_coverage.description: A need counts as satisfied only when Jev judges the kept evidence answers its question.
answer_aware_coverage.title: Answer Aware Coverage

answer_threshold.description: Probability the answer judgement must reach for a relevance-satisfied need to stay so.
answer_threshold.title: Answer Threshold

category_descriptions.description: What each evidence category means, offered to Jev when it chooses which categories to search.
category_descriptions.title: Category Descriptions

evaluable_threshold.description: Lowest probability that the gathered evidence is enough to evaluate the question; below it research reports the shortfall.
evaluable_threshold.title: Evaluable Threshold

max_claim_needs.description: Most claim checks for human-added options planned per run; the rest are named.
max_claim_needs.title: Max Claim Needs

max_targeted_needs.description: Most gap needs planned per research run; the rest are named, not researched.
max_targeted_needs.title: Max Targeted Needs

need_required_threshold.description: Probability that an evidence category is needed at which it becomes a required need.
need_required_threshold.title: Need Required Threshold

need_supporting_threshold.description: Probability that an evidence category is needed at which it becomes a supporting need (must not exceed the required threshold).
need_supporting_threshold.title: Need Supporting Threshold

ResearchConfig.title: ResearchConfig

bm25_b.description: Length-normalisation strength of the keyword ranking (0 none, 1 full); orders candidates only.
bm25_b.title: Bm25 B

bm25_k1.description: BM25 term-count saturation and length-normalisation strength (0 = none); orders only.
bm25_k1.title: Bm25 K1

coverage_relevance_threshold.description: Relevance a kept item needs to count towards a need's coverage (lower ones stay context).
coverage_relevance_threshold.title: Coverage Relevance Threshold

deny_globs.description: Path patterns retrieval must never read (secrets, build output).
deny_globs.title: Deny Globs

excerpt_context_lines.description: Lines of context kept around the best-matching lines of an excerpt.
excerpt_context_lines.title: Excerpt Context Lines

max_candidates.description: Most candidates gathered per need before reranking.
max_candidates.title: Max Candidates

max_explicit_locators.description: Most explicit locators fetched per request (`retrieval_request.explicit_locators`).
max_explicit_locators.title: Max Explicit Locators

max_query_terms.description: Most search terms one retrieval query carries (goal first, then hints, then need filler).
max_query_terms.title: Max Query Terms

max_section_lines.description: Longest section (lines) scored whole; a longer one is cut into windows of this many lines.
max_section_lines.title: Max Section Lines

path_match_weight.description: Score per rarity unit of each distinctive path word (a file NAMED after the topic).
path_match_weight.title: Path Match Weight

pool_fair_min_ratio.description: Share of the best score a source's candidate must reach to take a guaranteed place in the first rerank batch.
pool_fair_min_ratio.title: Pool Fair Min Ratio

pool_fair_share.description: Candidates per source guaranteed in the first batch if they score this share of the best.
pool_fair_share.title: Pool Fair Share

pool_sections_per_file.description: Sections of one file the FIRST rerank batch may hold (later pool places: sections_per_file).
pool_sections_per_file.title: Pool Sections Per File

registry_pin_min_terms.description: A JSON registry is pinned when this many query words are names in its vocabulary.
registry_pin_min_terms.title: Registry Pin Min Terms

relevance_threshold.description: Relevance a candidate needs to be kept as evidence at all.
relevance_threshold.title: Relevance Threshold

rerank_max_batches.description: Batches one need may judge; further ones only until it has enough evidence (rerank_min_items).
rerank_max_batches.title: Rerank Max Batches

rerank_max_per_need.description: Candidates one rerank batch sends to Jev (`max_candidates` is the pool); with `jev.max_questions_per_call` at least this large a batch is one call.
rerank_max_per_need.title: Rerank Max Per Need

rerank_min_items.description: A need judges more batches until this many items passed `relevance_threshold` ...
rerank_min_items.title: Rerank Min Items

rerank_stop_ratio.description: ... and skips one when the best unjudged candidate scores below this share of the judged.
rerank_stop_ratio.title: Rerank Stop Ratio

review_path_markers.description: File-name markers that identify a review of a run rather than evidence for it.
review_path_markers.title: Review Path Markers

review_quote_ratio.description: Goal share a document quotes (beside a run or trace id), or file-name marker, to review its run.
review_quote_ratio.title: Review Quote Ratio

satisfied_min_items.description: A need is `satisfied` only with at least this many kept items at or above `coverage_relevance_threshold` ...
satisfied_min_items.title: Satisfied Min Items

satisfied_strong_threshold.description: ... or with a single kept item whose relevance reaches this stronger bar.
satisfied_strong_threshold.title: Satisfied Strong Threshold

sections_per_file.description: Sections (headings, top-level keys, top-level defs) returned per file, best first.
sections_per_file.title: Sections Per File

self_reference_penalty.description: Factor on the relevance of a self-referencing candidate (cited ones are exempt).
self_reference_penalty.title: Self Reference Penalty

self_reference_ratio.description: A candidate repeating this share of the goal near-verbatim reviews the run asking, not evidence for it, and is demoted (0 disables this and the review test).
self_reference_ratio.title: Self Reference Ratio

source_candidate_floor.description: Fewest candidates a source may offer when it is small (capped by `max_candidates`).
source_candidate_floor.title: Source Candidate Floor

source_candidate_ratio.description: Candidates a source may offer per scanned file (bounded by `max_candidates`).
source_candidate_ratio.title: Source Candidate Ratio

top_k.description: Most evidence items kept per need.
top_k.title: Top K

min_confidence.description: Lowest provider confidence routing accepts for its answer.
min_confidence.title: Min Confidence

min_selected_probability.description: Lowest probability the chosen capability needs before routing selects it.
min_selected_probability.title: Min Selected Probability

on_insufficient_context.description: What routing does when the context cannot decide: ask a human or block the run.
on_insufficient_context.title: On Insufficient Context

SourceConfig.description: One entry of the source catalog (where evidence may come from).

automatic_research.description: Whether research may choose this source on its own; false means only explicit sources or locators select it.
automatic_research.title: Automatic Research

categories.description: Evidence categories the source can serve.
categories.title: Categories

deny_globs.description: Path patterns this source must never read, added to the global retrieval deny list.
deny_globs.title: Deny Globs

id.description: Unique id of the source, cited by evidence and by source restrictions.
id.title: Id

kind.description: How the source is read: repository text, knowledge map, graph query or host research.
kind.title: Kind

max_file_bytes.description: Largest file this source reads; null uses the global retrieval limit.
max_file_bytes.title: Max File Bytes

roots.description: Folders or files the source reads, relative to the repository root.
roots.title: Roots

surfaces.description: Named knowledge-map surfaces the source exposes.
surfaces.title: Surfaces

memory.description: Decision store and precedent lookup settings.

paths.description: Where run state and the capability registry live.

research.description: Thresholds and category meanings for planning research.
